name: premiere-uxp-mcp
description: UXP-first, readback-verified MCP automation for Adobe Premiere Pro 2026.

scripts.build: npm run build:native-bridge && npm run build -w @premiere-uxp/contracts && npm run build -w @premiere-uxp/mcp-server && npm run build -w @premiere-uxp/uxp-plugin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @premiere-uxp/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @premiere-uxp/mcp-server && npm run typecheck -w @premiere-uxp/uxp-plugin
scripts.test: npm run build -w @premiere-uxp/contracts && npm run build -w @premiere-uxp/mcp-server && vitest run
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
